agent_note: First-person retrospective narrator (attributions name Trevor Benson) recounting past events in past tense, punctuated by narrating-moment present commentary and heavy aphorism. Quotation marks survive in this book (q04902, q04912, q04921), so unmarked advisory passages were bucketed on register/generality rather than assumed to be dialogue -- that decision drives most of the large gnomic count. Event split 7 past / 2 present; both present event quotes (q04904, q04920) are the narrating present of a retrospective teller, not simultaneous narration, so the retrospective reading holds independent of the counts.
